stories.title: FBI investigating apparent hack of its key national criminal justice database
stories.summary: The bureau has historically been a frequent target for hackers.

stories.title: Endurance athlete swims Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war’s impact on wildlife
stories.summary: Lewis Pugh felt explosions and saw a tanker hit shortly after entering the water.

stories.title: Trump vows to work with Democrats to cap credit card interest rates at 10%
stories.summary: The proposal has faced opposition from banks and Republicans, but with Democrats controlling Congress, it may gain traction.

stories.title: A 10% drop for the stock market is unnerving, but it’s not that unusual
stories.summary: The fall for the S&P 500 is steep enough that Wall Street has a name for it: a “correction.”

stories.title: Anchorage’s short-term rental map removed after complaints from owners
stories.summary: The Anchorage municipal clerk says a “miscommunication” originally led to publication of short-term rental data.

stories.title: GOP set to block Trump Pentagon picks as other military moves face headwinds
stories.summary: With Republicans about to lose their majorities, the Trump administration is facing obstacles to key nominations as well as its planned defense budget.

stories.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro,’ setting off deadly burst of violence in Sinaloa
stories.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was one of the FBI’s 10 most wanted fugitives

stories.title: RFK Jr. vows to curb a measles crisis he initially underestimated
stories.summary: Federal officials must create a plan to regain measles elimination status. It won’t be easy, public health experts say.

stories.title: In secret memo, Hegseth restricts U.S.-Canada defense relationship
stories.summary: The classified directive is another provocation in the Trump administration’s feud with Ottawa. One U.S. official said it’s sure to be seen as a “slap in the face.”

stories.title: Opinion: The lights are still on in King Cove
stories.summary: After two years of economic hardship, the prospect of a renewed processing plant offers hope for the island community.

stories.title: New University of Alaska tuition structure raises some costs and cuts others for Alaska students
stories.summary: The move follows the UA Board of Regents cutting out-of-state tuition rates earlier this year, and officials say the new tuition structure is simpler.

stories.title: Anchorage School Board member resigns from seat to move to Lower 48
stories.summary: The remaining board members will appoint a new temporary member within 30 days.
